110.description: public secondary constructors expose creation while primary constructor stays private in class declaration

286.description: private companion object members are visible to instance members of the declaring class; covers function, property, and named companion; contrasts with next-point outside-class failure

277.description: a private primary constructor is reachable from companion factories; covers plain class, generic class, and multi-arg factory; contrasts with previous-point outside-class failure, with p-85 singleton-cache focus, and with p-109/p-110 secondary-constructor focus

109.description: private primary constructor is reachable only via companion factory or secondary constructor in class declaration
